patterns: tell me about placements at sdit
what is the placement record of sdit
i want to know about the overall placement scenario and track record of the college
response: SDIT has consistently maintained an excellent recruitment record. On average, 90-95% of eligible final year students are placed through campus placements. Historical offer letters: 427+ (2016), 452+ (2017), 461+ (2018), 480+ (2019), 492+ (2020). Placements begin in the 7th semester with participation from top-tier companies across IT, engineering, finance, and consulting sectors. The college also conducts pool campus drives involving other engineering colleges from the Mangalore region.

what kind of training does the placement department provide to students
response: The Department of Placement & Training provides comprehensive support: Pre-placement training on aptitude, logical skills, technical knowledge, and communication for 2nd, 3rd, and final year students. Activities include mock interviews by experts, placement talks by resource persons, resume building workshops, PDP programs, bridge courses, technology training programs, competitive exam preparation (CAT, GMAT, aptitude), and assistance with industrial internships. The department also organizes industrial visits for early industry exposure.

response: The Placement and Training Department has dedicated facilities for recruitment drives including a seminar hall for company presentations, group discussion rooms, conferencing facilities, and interview & discussion rooms.

patterns: what are the goals of the placement department
what does the placement cell aim to do
response: The Placement Department goals are: to assist graduates in developing a balanced set of technical and interpersonal skills with a positive attitude; to act as a nodal agency for forging technology alliances between SDIT departments and industries; to provide quality technical manpower to suit organizational needs; and to develop as a single-window point for career counselling and higher learning in engineering and technology.
